description: Usinas Hidrelétricas UHEs - ANEEL 2020 (Minas Gerais) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada com a localização dos barramentos das Usinas Hidrelétricas - UHEs no Brasil. Segundo a Resolução Normativa ANEEL 875/2020, Usinas Hidrelétricas são aproveitamentos hidrelétricos que possuem as seguintes características: I - potência instalada superior a 5.000 kW e igual ou inferior a 50.000 kW, desde que não sejam enquadrados como Pequena Central Hidrelétrica e estejam ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Usinas hidrelétricas, Hidrelétricas, Empreendimentos hidrelétricos, Energia hidrelétrica, UHE. The portal shows 2023-04-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
